model_meta.description: A compliant polygonal-cell barrier that deforms under externally applied force while retaining barrier integrity; compliant members provide a default shape upon force removal.

subsystems.description: Shape-shifting surface architecture comprising adjacent overlapping side members with compliant flexures and plate segments. Claim 1 specifies a plurality of layers; separately described embodiments include a single polygonal cell and a tiled array of polygonal cells.
functional_basis: deform surface under externally applied force

subsystems.description: Overlapping flat plate segments form the barrier surface and move relative to adjacent segments; thin curved shells are a separately identified variant, not a simultaneous required form.
Compliant portions of side members guide node motion substantially along a straight path and elastically tend toward the default shape after force removal.

item_flows.name: Surface deformation motion
item_flows.notes: Generic mechanical motion/change of surface shape under applied force; listed shape changes are alternative possibilities, not simultaneous outputs.

requirements.statement: Maintain a contiguous line-of-sight barrier while the surface deforms.
Keep all surface edges substantially within the structure boundary during deformation.
requirements.rationale: Claim 3; stated as a dependent-claim feature.

requirements.statement: Return toward the original/default shape when external force is removed.
requirements.rationale: Claim 4; description also attributes return tendency to compliant members.

steps.description: Receive externally applied force at the surface boundary.
Flexure side members deform and guide node motion; overlapping segments slide or pivot relative to one another.
Change surface shape while retaining contiguous line-of-sight barrier coverage.
Compliant members tend to return the surface toward its original/default shape.
